data.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: The slaad can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The slaad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The slaad's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). The slaad can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, mage hand
1/day: fireball
2/day each: fear, invisibility (self only)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The slaad makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws or staff. Alternatively, it uses its Hurl Flame twice.

actions.name: Bite (Slaad Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw (Slaad Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage. The fire ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.
